steps.message: Open the contacts app. Clear any pop-ups that may appear by granting all permissions that are required.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i contact"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i contact""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "dumpsys package com.android.contacts | grep permission | grep -v granted=false | head -30"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "dumpsys package com.android.contacts | grep permission | grep -v granted=false | head -30""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "pm list permissions -g -d | grep -A5 'contacts\|phone\|storage\|camera\|microphone' | head -50"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list permissions -g -d | grep -A5 'contacts\|phone\|storage\|camera\|microphone' | head -50""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "dumpsys package com.google.android.contacts | grep 'permission' | head -50"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "dumpsys package com.google.android.contacts | grep 'permission' | head -50""
